en: Multi-view postcard showing dramatic rocky peaks and narrow ledges of a high‑mountain via ferrata route. The upper main photo labels individual peaks and passes with Italian names (e.g., Sentinella, Camp. Alto, Sfulmini, Torre, C. d. Armi, Bocch. Camp. Alto, Bocch. d. Armi) and traces the route with a red line. The bottom half has two smaller images: one of a hiker walking along a very narrow path cut into a cliff and another of a similar exposed rocky traverse. Large red text across the middle reads "VIA DELLE BOCCHETTE".
